caption: The drawing shows a single object: a three-legged metal pot with a long, straight handle extending horizontally from one side. The handle is solid and tapers slightly as it extends outward, ending in a small rounded tip with a hole near the end. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the dark pot, and there are no other objects or details in the composition.
title: Iron Kettle
